import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    if len(df) > 0 and len(numeric_cols) > 0:
        numeric_data = df.loc[:, numeric_cols].copy()

        # Make MinMaxScaler robust to missing values if they are present.
        if numeric_data.isna().any().any():
            numeric_data = numeric_data.apply(
                lambda s: s.fillna(s.min() if s.notna().any() else 0)
            )

        scaled = MinMaxScaler().fit_transform(numeric_data)
        result = pd.DataFrame(scaled, columns=numeric_cols, index=df.index)
        result["Average"] = result.mean(axis=1)

    elif len(df) > 0:
        result["Average"] = pd.Series([float("nan")] * len(df), index=df.index)

    else:
        for col in numeric_cols:
            result[col] = pd.Series(dtype="float64", index=df.index)
        result["Average"] = pd.Series(dtype="float64", index=df.index)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if len(result) > 0 and "Average" in result.columns and result["Average"].notna().any():
        x = list(range(len(result)))
        ax.bar(x, result["Average"].to_numpy())
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels([str(idx) for idx in result.index], rotation=45, ha="right")
    else:
        ax.text(
            0.5,
            0.5,
            "No numeric data to plot",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
        )
        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.set_yticks([])

    ax.set_xlabel("Row")
    ax.set_ylabel("Average")
    ax.set_title("Row Averages After MinMax Scaling")
    plt.tight_layout()

    return result, ax
